name: Pegah’s Kitchen
notes: First-party PDF menu linked directly from the restaurant's own site (pegahskitchen.com), filename dated 4-01-25 (April 2025 price update), so prices are recent and not stale. Transcribed all named, individually-priced items across the PDF's sections (Pegah's Classics, Breakfast Skillets, Three Egg Omelets, Eggs Benedict, Breakfast Burritos, Waffles, Pancakes, French Toast, Stuffed French Toast, Burgers, Sandwiches, Salads, Soup & Chili, Beverages, Dessert). Kids Menu (6 named choices) and Senior Menu (6 named choices across breakfast/lunch dayparts) publish one flat real price per choice rather than per-item, so each named choice is listed as its own dish at that flat price (consistent with how category-level pricing was handled for Tortilla Mia earlier in this batch); Senior Menu items are suffixed '(Senior)' since some names would otherwise collide with regular-menu dishes. Side Orders are grouped into 3 explicit price tiers ($6/$5/$4) rather than one price per line, so each named side is listed individually at its tier's real published price. Dropped: Toppings (pancake/waffle add-ons, $2-4), 'add cheese +$.50', 'double burger +$5', 'substitute fries +$1', and half-order variants of already-listed Classics items (all true modifiers/options on a base dish, not standalone menu line items with their own heading, consistent with how the Margarita flavor add-ons were excluded for Tortilla Mia). 123 final dishes, no duplicates, no invented prices.
